camel_example: aliyun ndr UpdateProtoLogDeliveryStatus --region cn-hangzhou --StatusList.1.Site global --StatusList.1.AttackLogStatus 1 --StatusList.1.DeliveryType sls --StatusList.1.ProtoLogStatus 1 --DeliveryType sls --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Updates the delivery switches for protocol logs and attack logs of specified sites in batches. For each site in StatusList, the system writes both types of switches simultaneously. If either switch is omitted, log delivery for the corresponding type is disabled. To modify only one type of switch, call DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus to query the current configuration and pass the current value of the other switch
description_zh: 批量更新指定站点的协议日志和攻击日志投递开关。对 StatusList 中的每个站点，系统同时写入两类开关。任一开关省略时，对应类型的日志投递会被关闭。只修改一类开关时，请先调用 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 查询当前配置，并将另一类开关的当前值一并传入
kebab_example: aliyun ndr update-proto-log-delivery-status --delivery-type sls --status-list Site=global AttackLogStatus=1 ProtoLogStatus=1 DeliveryType=sls --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProtoLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en: The compatibility parameter. Valid value: sls. The current update is based on the DeliveryType of each item in StatusList. Passing only this parameter does not update the switches
parameters.help_zh: 兼容参数，取值为 sls。当前更新以 StatusList 中各项的 DeliveryType 为准，仅传入本参数不会更新开关
parameters.name: delivery_type

fields.help_en:
The attack log delivery switch. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
If omitted, it is treated as 0, which disables attack log delivery for the site. To retain the current state, explicitly pass the queried current value
fields.help_zh: 攻击日志投递开关。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。省略时按 0 处理，会关闭该站点的攻击日志投递。如需保留当前状态，请显式传入查询到的当前值
fields.name: attack_log_status

fields.help_en: The delivery type. You must specify sls for each site
fields.help_zh: 投递类型，每个站点均须传入 sls
fields.name: delivery_type

fields.help_en:
The protocol log delivery switch. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
If omitted, it is treated as 0, which disables protocol log delivery for the site. To retain the current state, explicitly pass the queried current value
fields.help_zh: 协议日志投递开关。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启。省略时按 0 处理，会关闭该站点的协议日志投递。如需保留当前状态，请显式传入查询到的当前值
fields.name: proto_log_status

fields.help_en: The identifier of the site to be updated. This parameter cannot be empty. Use the sites returned by DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus
fields.help_zh: 待更新的站点标识，不能为空。使用 DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus 返回的站点
fields.name: site

parameters.help_en: The list of switch configurations for the sites to be updated. This parameter cannot be empty. Each item must include DeliveryType and Site, and explicitly provide ProtoLogStatus and AttackLogStatus. The system updates only the sites in the list, but writes both switches for each listed site simultaneously. If either switch is omitted, it is treated as 0, and log delivery for that type is disabled
parameters.help_zh: 待更新站点的开关配置列表，不能为空。每项传入 DeliveryType 和 Site，并显式提供 ProtoLogStatus 和 AttackLogStatus。系统仅更新列表中的站点，但对每个列出的站点会同时写入两个开关。任一开关省略时按 0 处理，该类型的日志投递会被关闭
parameters.name: status_list

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The request result message. This parameter describes the cause of the error when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
